description: THE COMMONS. The heart of the Thornwarren — a trodden clearing around a central fire pit, ringed by lean-tos of salvaged panel and stretched hide. Wildblood of every shape drift through: scaled, spurred, extra-eyed, unbothered. The elder they call the Chorus holds court to the south; a trader's lean-to sits west, and a surgeon's tent east. You are very obviously new meat.
name: The Commons
